متفرقات.title: The tool trap
متفرقات.description: Today I visited Biltema, one of Sweden's biggest hardware and home improvement stores. Everywhere there were people, mostly men, looking at tools. Holding them with a look on their face that said, "Hmm, maybe this could be useful." I have a feeling that quite a few of those tools will never be used, and the projects they were meant for will never be finished. I see it all the time when doing house inspections. Shiny, expensive tools lying around and "a work in progress" behind every other door.
متفرقات.source: I’m Robert from Sweden. This is my corner of the web for everyday thoughts, small adventures, and reflections along the way.

فن وتصميم.description: Hong Kong is so rich in details and keeps many layers of information I’d like to unveil with time. Fascinating place. I didn’t plan to stay for many days. In my dreams I would like to spend months there, writing high above in a quiet studio in one of those skyscrapers, but in the higher floors, not in a second floor or so (How inelegant that would be!). But that's is a task for my future self.
